info.name: Shop Keeper API
info.description: One request per API route. Import it with shop-keeper.postman_environment.json and select the "Shop Keeper local" environment. The backend runs with AUTH_TEST_MODE=true and the catalog loaded (php artisan catalog:load): `test:<email>` stands in for Google and `000000` for every emailed code. Run the folders in order the first time: tokens, ids, emails, devices and barcodes are saved in the environment, so any request can then be sent again on its own.

Starts a new email account each time: email, device_id and new_device_id are generated before the request.

item.description: Run after "7. Payments": the product of "4. Products" has a stock of 0 once its purchase is cancelled. The opening stock is accepted once per product; sent again with new ids it answers 422 product_id.opening_already_set.

Two units broken. The stock goes down by 2, to 28. A loss may take the stock below zero.
The merchant counts 25 units while the app shows 28. The server records counted minus shown (-3), so movements recorded since the count still count. The stock becomes 25.
